overview: A multi-agent AI content production studio that turns a brief into scripts, visuals, and finished video cuts.
features: Run a brief through a multi-agent production pipeline
Review and accept generated scripts and visuals
Choose which prompt to turn into a video
Generate video with Kling 3.0 or Veo 3.1 via Replicate
Watch generation progress and play the finished video
Re-run generation and manage generated videos
